title: An Engineer's Checklist of Logging Best Practices
summary: 10-point checklist covering structuring and consolidating log entries, unique identifiers, standardized field names, retention, alerting, and avoiding sensitive data.
when-to-read: Read when establishing or auditing a logging strategy, or investigating a production incident where log quality is part of the problem. Do not read for general debugging methodology (see troubleshooting) — this is about log design and hygiene, not investigative technique.
